newsitem.title: USA: NeoPharm says it can't explain stock volume.
newsitem.headline: NeoPharm says it can't explain stock volume.

text.p: NeoPharm Inc said Wednesday it was unaware of any events that would account for heavy trading volume in its shares in recent days.
NeoPharm Chief Financial Officer David Riggs said "it was business as usual" at the company's operations, according to a statement released by NeoPharm.
The bio-pharmaceutical company said volume in its stock had increased to more than 125,000 shares on both Wednesday and Tuesday, May 27, from average trading volume of 5,000 to 10,000 shares.
